authoring.description: Compose portable AIConfig intent and typed Local or Cloud implementation recommendations without copying an engine editor.

authoring.includeDescription: Include a description in the portable artifact
authoring.provenanceHint: Required, non-empty JSON object for export.
authoring.licenseHint: Required, structurally non-empty JSON value for export.
authoring.optionalJsonHint: Optional portable JSON. Leave blank to omit.
authoring.capabilitiesBody: Each CapabilityContract has one AIConfig recommendation route, standardized feature requirements, defaults, and an optional typed Local implementation intent.
authoring.featuresHint: Comma- or line-separated exact feature IDs.

authoring.verifiedContentHint: Use canonical sha256:… content identity; strict policy requires it.
authoring.cloudRecommendationBody: Package implementation and provider-model target only. Runtime resolves the current account Connector and credential at execution time.
authoring.providerModelTargetHint: Use the exact provider, providerModelId, and remoteModelCatalogId selected on the Nimi-owned AIConfig surface. Runtime resolves only the current-account Connector bound by that catalog identity.
authoring.requirementsRuntimeTruth: Authoring projection only. The final requirement set is always the Runtime projection at commit time.
authoring.requirementsPending: Complete the typed Driver fields to display the SDK-derived requirement projection.

authoring.validationFailed: The current draft cannot be projected. Review the form; no output or configuration change was made.
authoring.exportReady: Export validation passed, including non-empty provenance and license.
authoring.exportNeedsMetadata: Journey preview is available, but export validation still needs attention.

authoring.importPreviewBody: Import yields an editable portable artifact only; it does not materialize owner or machine configuration.
